services.name: Shark Fishing
services.desc: We are proud to offer light tackle action inshore fishing charters for Bass, Bluefish, Cod, Mackerel, and Pollock. Captain Ben recommends 4-6 hour trips for inshore fishing but we can customize the trip based on your needs. Much like Family trips, these are usually within 5 miles of the coast offering calmer waters and protection from the coastline on windier days. The primary difference between family trips and inshore trips is that you will fish for a longer time and target bigger fish. Instead of dropping baits to the bottom and drifting to target smaller fish you are more likely to be casting live baits or using chunk baits. services.name: Ocean Cruises
services.desc: Enjoy a Beautiful sunset ocean cruise aboard the Kristin K. Bring some friends and grab some dinner while cruising around in Casco Bay and surrounding areas. Maybe you would like to see some of the islands on the Bay on a Scenic Island Tour. Or maybe you would like to see the many beautiful lighthouses and historic landmarks on the coast. Perhaps you want Captain Ben to look for wildlife such as seals and porpoise and whales. Let us know what interests you and Captain Ben can put together a wonderful evening cruise for you. We look forward to getting you out on the water to enjoy some of Maine’s Finest! Captain Ben is a family man himself. Which is why he offers a low-cost 2 hour family fun

blurb: Guests can fish for species like Shark, Sea Bass, Cod, Bluefish, Mackerel, Haddock, and Pollock on various fishing trips including family, inshore, ground, and shark fishing. Ocean cruises and tours include seal and whale watching, dinner and sunset cruises, and scenic island tours. Captain Ben offers trips suitable for families, beginners, and experienced anglers.
